messages.website.content.5f437a04c0: Create a character, help the villagers and learn your first skill as you take your first steps.
messages.website.content.a72b546158: Choose Start Adventure to create a character; no account is needed. Progress stays in this browser. Changing devices or browsers does not transfer your character, and clearing site data deletes local saves. Use a normal window in your usual browser.
messages.website.content.2411928855: Warriors fight up close, Wizards cast ranged spells, and Taoists combine summons with support. A Warrior is a straightforward way to learn the controls. All three classes receive their first skill through the opening quests.
messages.website.content.d111903ff4: Speak to the Novice Guide and accept First Steps. Defeat 5 Hens, return to turn it in, then follow Meet the Butcher and Provisions for the Road. Turning in quests unlocks the next steps, so do more than hunt monsters.
messages.website.content.8ade8bd39f: Step 3 · Use your skill and gather supplies
messages.website.content.7e2f0cae84: Turn in First Steps after defeating 5 Hens to receive your first class skill book and potions. Open your bag and double-click the book to learn.
messages.website.content.0bb7fafe6c: Step 4 · Equip Yourself and Stock Up
messages.website.content.03f70fb8f9: New characters start with a Wooden Sword and cloth armor equipped, and a health potion bound to 1. Maomao’s Blessing is placed in your bag automatically: press B and double-click it to equip. Add mana potions to the second hotbar slot when available. Check supplies and bag space before leaving.
messages.website.content.2239585856: Step 5 · Take the station route to the tomb
messages.website.content.43324711b6: The Next step panel follows the early quest chain through the chicken hunt, Butcher visit, venison, Blacksmith trial, board delivery, Longyang Grass and Scorpion Tails. Turning in Longyang Grass rewards one Town Scroll. For the tail quest, use the village or Bichon station to teleport near the Orc Tomb entrance, enter Floor 1 and pick up a scorpion tail. Use the scroll to return to your home town, then visit the Peddler. The village Peddler sells more Town Scrolls. Continue with finding Xiaobao and reporting back to the Blacksmith before exploring the city.
messages.website.content.870fc89f61: Try the next map when you can comfortably defeat the monsters where you are. Improve your skills, supplies and equipment before challenging bosses. Suggested map levels are guidance, not a guarantee that your current loadout will succeed.
messages.website.content.f0f4959872: Learn movement, stationary attacks, potion recovery and how to leave safely.
messages.website.content.a7f4e2eaf3: The game is designed primarily for a keyboard and mouse. Click the ground to move or a monster to attack. Approach an NPC and click to talk. Hold Shift while attacking to stay in place when positioning matters. The full guide is readable on a phone; a computer is recommended for combat.
messages.website.content.62600ff942: Open Skills to review learned abilities and follow the in-game prompts to assign shortcuts. Passive skills usually need no activation; spells need enough MP. Skill rank and character level are separate things.
messages.website.content.2f4bea7af3: Automatic recovery uses the first two item hotbar slots. Set your HP and MP thresholds in Assist. Ordinary Health and Mana Potions recover over 5 seconds; instant-recovery items work separately. Keep watching your position while recovering.
messages.website.content.2e01948bf7: Click an item’s ground icon or name to pick it up. Watch bag space and weight. When you return to town, sell unwanted equipment, store materials and repair your gear.
messages.website.content.72a0414355: The System menu offers manual saving, and the game also saves automatically. The simulation pauses in the background. Save before leaving. Re-entering returns you to your home town and rebuilds the map’s monsters.
messages.website.content.e49c2c5f9b: Choose by combat style, then learn how your first skills lead into later progression.
messages.website.content.64a94c380f: Complete First Trial to receive the Fencing book, then use it from your bag to learn, granting 3/5/7 attack and 3/5/8 accuracy at ranks 1–3. Complete the blacksmith trial to receive the Heavy Strike book; use it from your bag at level 5 to learn the passive skill: every fourth damaging basic hit deals 150% damage; the count resets after 8 seconds without a hit. Learning Slaying replaces it. Slaying has a 20% trigger chance and deals 150%/160%/170% of maximum attack at ranks 1–3.
messages.website.content.aa3e174039: First Trial rewards the Fireball book. Use it from your bag to learn your opening attack. Complete the blacksmith trial to receive the Great Fireball book, then use it from your bag at level 5; its book also drops in the Ancient Tomb. Later ranks still require levels 21/23. Watch your mana and keep your distance.
messages.website.content.08b3b22543: First Trial rewards the Spirit Servant book; the blacksmith trial rewards the Soul Fireball book, usable at level 5. Learn both by using their books from your bag. A present servant shares experience up to level 7. Death resets its growth; resummoning a living servant and saving retain it. After 5 seconds out of combat it restores 1% health every 5 seconds. Learn Healing at level 7, hover your servant on desktop or select it on mobile, then cast to heal it. Soul Fireball and Poisoning consume no talismans or powder, and shops no longer sell these materials.
messages.website.content.c30f36f6e7: If a Skill Is Not Working
messages.website.content.ddc79039ef: Check your character level, whether you have used the right skill book, and any prerequisites. Then check MP and cooldowns. The skill guide follows current learning requirements, which may differ from older guides.
messages.website.content.16222b7b21: Learn how to judge equipment requirements, stats, random affixes and quality bonuses.
messages.website.content.27aba053dc: Can You Equip It, and Does It Suit You?
messages.website.content.2fe6005f5d: Check class, level and other requirements first. Warriors favour Attack, Wizards Magic and Taoists Taoism, alongside the HP, defence, Accuracy and speed they need. An item’s name alone does not tell you how useful it is.
messages.website.content.3dc2ac9ed4: Exceptional stat points and extra affixes are separate layers of random progression. Equipment must meet the exceptional-bonus conditions before it can roll the corresponding affixes. Higher-tier gear has better late-game affix chances. Updates do not automatically reroll old equipment.
messages.website.content.cf68555505: Luck affects the value rolled within your attack-stat range. It is not drop rate or a critical-damage multiplier. Compare Luck, exceptional points, critical effects and affixes as distinct mechanics.
messages.website.content.5232de03ac: At least 5 usable items of exactly the same quality activate that quality’s bonus; only the highest eligible tier applies. Broken items do not count. Current bonuses are Excellent 10%, Peerless 12%, Legendary 14% and Epic 16%. Check the active-effect icon for requirements and the applied bonus.
messages.website.content.ef9e3b8af2: Keep Materials and Check Before Replacing Gear
messages.website.content.f5735cc7d3: Enhancement, forging and recipes use different materials. Check the selected equipment, quantities and Gold cost before confirming. Store rare materials until you know how you want to use them.
messages.website.content.9de291a679: Drag in materials, check the result and learn the forge slots and eight-slot cube.
messages.website.content.7ea677e73c: Open Forge, drag equipment from your bag into the lower equipment slot, then put the matching materials in the five upper slots. Right-click to remove a selection. Incompatible items cannot enter the slot. The current quote shows fees, skill levels and apprenticeship requirements.
messages.website.content.8949c914e0: The Cube Has Eight Material Slots
messages.website.content.0991e00049: Open Pandora’s Box and drag materials from your bag into its two rows of four slots. Click or right-click a slot to remove a selection. Placing items does not consume them; confirming the recipe consumes the selected items and quantities.
messages.website.content.31c7478909: The cube identifies a recipe from the materials placed inside. If it is incomplete, check the types and quantities. Stacked items contribute the required amount: for example, 3 Random Teleport Scrolls can make 1 Town Teleport Scroll. A stack is not counted as just one scroll.
messages.website.content.3e7b546f30: Each operation has its own conditions. Read the result and cost before confirming, especially chance-based operations such as Fusion. The recipe directory shows the current configuration; the confirmation panel provides the final quote.
messages.website.content.95f449971d: Prepare supplies, find entrances and distinguish boss respawns from timed challenges.
messages.website.content.5764a7bfa3: Bring potions, a way home and enough bag space. Confirm your home town. The map guide lists suggested levels, connections and boss spawn points. Boss coordinates mark spawn centres; monsters may move during exploration and combat.
messages.website.content.1de6fdbb5d: When a Boss Is Too Strong
messages.website.content.4653a08cd2: Retreat, improve your current-stage skills and equipment, and study the boss’s attacks and surroundings before trying again. Suggested levels cannot replace judging your loadout and positioning. Avoid drawing a large pack into the fight.
messages.website.content.ff3f790f66: Watch the challenge timer. Clear the required monsters and deal with the reward chest promptly when it appears. A normal map’s boss respawn timer is different from the time remaining in a treasure-map challenge.
messages.website.content.2019b8a7e2: From Lava Hell to Silent Ice Valley
messages.website.content.07fbb4b924: Defeating the lava boss opens a temporary passage to a deeper part of the same map. From there, use the fixed entrance to Silent Ice Valley. The return entrance leads back to the deeper lava area. If the temporary passage expires, its opening conditions must be met again.
messages.website.content.ff32c82664: If You Cannot Find an Entrance
messages.website.content.15462baa5b: Confirm your current map and coordinates, then check the listed connections. Some passages depend on quests, boss defeats or timing. A recorded map connection is not necessarily open at all times.
messages.website.content.1f474060ae: Local Saves & Cross-Device Sync: What Works Now
messages.website.content.eb474b385f: cloud saves cross-device sync new computer new browser missing character Mac saves
messages.website.content.2f727c5f99: Cross-device sync is planned. Learn how BackMir currently saves locally, what happens when you change computers, how offline play works and how to investigate missing progress.
messages.website.content.68f762bdf4: This website currently offers guest play. Creating a character and continuing the game require no account, and game saves are not uploaded.
messages.website.content.252998e8b5: Saves Belong to a Browser and Site Address
messages.website.content.4232adeb57: Progress is stored in the browser’s site storage. Return using the same browser and site address to continue. Different domains, ports, browser profiles and devices have separate save storage.
messages.website.content.497bbef175: Local saves are encrypted. Older saves migrate automatically with updates while retaining characters. When online, the game checks the official-site connection and game version using a site session cookie; it does not upload characters or saves. This does not certify progress as cheat-free.
messages.website.content.30775ac3fa: Character selection, the game core and maps load in stages. Downloaded content remains available offline. A first visit or an uncached map or asset still needs a connection. Use the System menu to download the full offline resources when needed.
messages.website.content.5e53cff6c5: Use a normal browser window and allow site storage. Save manually from the System menu; automatic saving also runs during play. Clearing site data, uninstalling the browser or closing a private session may erase local progress. There is currently no cloud copy to restore.
messages.website.content.1455d97ab0: Why Did I Return to Town After Reloading?
messages.website.content.3685706c7f: Character progress is saved, but the map’s monster state is not a permanent save. Re-entering returns you to your home town and rebuilds the monsters. This is the current single-player save behaviour.
messages.website.content.6d083bfcd3: Save import, export and cloud recovery are not available. Save from the System menu before leaving, and keep the original browser and site data. Continue on the original device until sync becomes available. Signing into a browser account does not transfer your game characters.
messages.website.content.335d9bd025: Keep only one game tab open in a browser to avoid competing save writes. Cross-device sync is planned; account access, uploading, loading and conflict handling will be explained when it launches. Saves cannot currently be read on another device.
messages.website.content.a841be0f03: Start here for stuck quests, missing skills or a character you cannot find.
messages.website.content.ba56dc329f: Why Do I Have No Skills?
messages.website.content.d1877385ea: Turn in First Steps after defeating 5 Hens to receive your first class skill book and potions. Open your bag and double-click the book to learn. The blacksmith trial rewards your second class skill book. Use it from your bag at level 5. Heavy Strike books are quest rewards only and no longer drop.
messages.website.content.1bf1f2f889: Why Can I Not Turn In a Quest?
messages.website.content.b2086bab1c: Check that you accepted it, have the required kills or items, and are speaking to the correct turn-in NPC. The quest directory lists prerequisites and both NPCs; acceptance and turn-in locations can differ.
messages.website.content.3d3bc761ee: Why Can I Not Travel Somewhere?
messages.website.content.a065af74d9: Town and map travel may require main-quest progress. Check the NPC’s dialogue conditions and your current map. Setting a home town changes your return destination; it does not unlock every map.
messages.website.content.9ba3b12da0: My Character Is Missing in Another Browser
messages.website.content.efb040e71f: Guest saves do not sync across browsers or devices. Return to the original site address, browser and profile. If its site data has been deleted, the current guest version cannot recover it from the cloud.
messages.website.content.49a76d335c: How Can I Submit Feedback or a Guide?
messages.website.content.9ee2fa2095: Player submissions, comments and feedback are planned after accounts are introduced. There is no online submission form yet. The current site provides the playable game and readable guides; a future submission feature will show confirmation and handling progress.
